theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: The theme leads the rotation with top momentum rank, full breadth participation, solid durability (0.7), and trend-gate eligibility, which the backtest shows helps avoid shake-outs. Not crowded. Despite rank not forecasting returns, the absolute-trend discipline favours holding the leader as long as trend and narrative cohesion persist.
theses.dissent: A sharp downturn in global industrial demand (e.g., China slowdown) could reverse copper prices and deflate the base metals narrative, even with broad participation.

While still trend-gate eligible, the poor momentum and narrative absence justify an underweight against the broad market.
evidence: Eligible but weak relative to leader
